title: The Unsolved Mathematics Atlas
description: A reproducible, ranked, research-grade dossier of 106 open mathematical problems across 38 fields, paired with a standalone multi-kernel Lean 4.35.0 formal verification core, automated primary-source citation auditing, and a deterministic RAG corpus. Independent research; not peer-reviewed.
notes: Dual-licensed: prose/data under CC BY 4.0 (LICENSE), code and Lean 4 formal proofs under MIT (LICENSE-CODE). Human author directed conceptualization, scoping, formal statement-fidelity auditing, and curation; AI tools were used as disclosed drafting/engineering instruments (see CLAIMS.md and formal/formalization.yaml).
